synopsis: Chapter 12 identifies IEC 61508-3 tool classes T1 to T3 as a reference regime for tool qualification [f9759]. The glossary identifies the edition as IEC 61508-3:2010 and explains that these classes guide how much qualification a simulator or other tool needs when its output is relied on [f15269]. This use specifically includes tools whose outputs become safety evidence; the supplied facts do not specify individual class criteria or assign a simulator to a class [f12055, f15269].

relations.note: Both identify T1–T3 as the booklet’s reference regime for tool qualification.
Identifies the 2010 edition and explains qualification according to reliance on tool output.
Both describe using T1–T3 to qualify simulators or other tools whose outputs are relied on.
